spans.text: Crackle—crackle—
Countless pixels emerge from the void, coalescing into a land of pure white that extends into the distance.
The feeling of suspension fades, and CMR-30 feels the solid weight of gravity once more.
Crash!
CMR-30's knees give out from underneath her; she would have fallen over if not for Thompson.
Whew... Thank you so much!
No need for the pleasantries.
Simulations usually adjust our abilities depending on the scenario, but this is a rarer semi-realistic simulation where everything's in tune with the real world.
Just think of it as a combat drill. You'll get used to it.
CMR-30 nods and surveys the surroundings—
The four find themselves standing shoulder-to-shoulder in a snowfield, a stark contrast to the classroom they were in moments ago.
A transparent barrier glowing with blue light quarantines them from the outside world.
A timer slowly counts down on the barrier, reading just over nine minutes.
Look carefully, rookie, we're in the "prep zone" of the simulation. That barrier is the boundary.
Once we cross it, the enemies will be alerted to our position, and the barrier goes poof—that's when the simulation begins for real.
What's the timer on the wall?
That's the timer for the prep zone disappearing. We can hardly just sit here 'til the end of time, right?
Once the timer's done, the battle will begin by itself, just like if we crossed the boundary ourselves.
That's about it, any other questions?
No, thank you, Captain!
Good! Gather here, everyone!
Type 80 and Ceno drag their feet over, gathering into a group under Thompson's leadership.
I'm going to convene Squad Supplementary Exam's first strategy meeting.
First things first, self-introductions.
Do we three really have to go through this? We just need the new one here to spill her secrets.
Eh? Me?
Now the focal point of attention, she hesitates for a moment before clearing her throat.
Ah, ahem... I'm a recent addition to Griffin, CMR-30.
I specialize in combat and tennis, and I also serve as the captain of the new recruit squad. Nice to meet you all!
Hi, I'm the outgoing & lively Carcano M1891, you can call me Cano.
I also have a lovely and dependable little sister, I hope you'll keep that—guh!
Thompson presses a finger into Ceno's head with considerable force.
Enough of that. Not a word of truth is coming out of that mouth of yours. I'll do it.
Over here on the left with the glasses, putting on the friendly act, is Type 80. She's got one hell of a temper;
Don't worry about her performance on a written test. When she gets into the action she's one of the best to ever do it.
This stone-faced liar here is Carcano M91/38, or Ceno.
She's a bit of a jokester usually, but she's a good one when the time calls for it. Of course, she's also your senior here.
Eh...
CMR-30 carefully contemplates the two "publicly executed" faces in front of her, clearly doubting Thompson's words of praise.
And me, I'm Thompson. I've been on the job the longest out of anyone here, and I'm up there even for a veteran around here.
That about does it.
Anyway, just stick with me today. I'll make sure you all get a clean pass!
Yes! Thank you, Captain!
CMR-30 stands upright, her eyes filled with admiration.
We've got five minutes left, what should we do?
Thompson peruses the system menus, falling silent.
Generally, a map of the combat area is sent to us before the simulation begins, but we've got nothing here...
Wait... I think I get it!
What is it?
Remember when Kalina said that this simulation would be relevant to the contents of the exam?
That means that we might have one of the Commander's older battles on our hands...
Since it's history, then we should be able to figure out our surroundings by memory!
Huh, so that's how it is.
I've got it.
Snow in winter, and this familiar smell of smoke... Rather hard to forget this, isn't it?
Uh... What are you talking about?
Which campaign was this?
Time's short, so I'll explain.
The stage being simulated is Zone S03... Back then, the Boss brought Griffin here to rescue a Doll squad from an unforeseen helicopter crash...
That's what this place is!
I remember, it was Sangvis back then!
The study materials mentioned that this was one of the most important encounters, since it was a turning point in the Commander's career...
Yup.
It was here that Griffin captured a high-ranking Sangvis leader for the first time, and that's how the Boss caught Mr. Kryuger's attention.
Incredible, Captain! You remember so clearly!
Of course! I was there myself.
Everything on the mountain was under snow, and the airport was out of supplies too. Rough times...
Oi, when are you two going to finish gossiping?
Type 80 impatiently interrupts their conversation.
Patience, Type 80.
Passing the exam is naturally important, but an opportunity to tell someone new about some good old history shouldn't be passed up, right?
This stupid place doesn't even have bubblegum, I wanna get the hell out!
Just target practice, right? I'll do it if you won't!
Hey, hold on—
Crackle.
Before Thompson can react, Type 80 has already crossed the boundary!
The barrier fades almost instantly, and the earth soon begins to rumble.
I-it's starting?
Looks like it.
...Tsk, she sure is in a hurry!
You two, find cover! I'll provide support!
